text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is the Olympic games.
Last(x) ::: x is the last event.
In(x, y) ::: x was in location y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in event y.
Premises:
OlympicGames(olympicGames) ∧ Last(olympicGames) ∧ In(olympicGames, tokyo) ::: The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
SportingEvent(worldChampionships) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
